name: io.github.vmvtech/esig-mcp
title: e-sig MCP
description: MCP server for agent-driven e-signature workflows over @e-sig/core — agents prepare and track envelopes; cryptographic control of signing stays with humans by default.

environmentVariables.name: ESIG_MCP_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: At-rest encryption passphrase (>=24 characters) for this server's private key material.

environmentVariables.name: ESIG_MCP_DELIVERY
environmentVariables.description: Signing-link delivery channel: file | webhook (see README's Security model section).
